# netactuate_platform_looking_glass (Data Source)

Runs a platform looking glass query and returns the API response.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_platform_looking_glass" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `action` (String) Looking glass action query parameter.
- `full` (Number) Looking glass full query parameter.
- `location` (String) Looking glass location query parameter.
- `target` (String) Looking glass target query parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `raw_json` (String) Complete looking glass execution response as JSON.
